title: Sliding window rate limiter admits one extra call

cases.name: limit_two_burst
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(2, 10)
result = [rl.allow(0), rl.allow(1), rl.allow(2), rl.allow(3)]

cases.name: expiry_at_exactly_window
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(2, 10)
out = [rl.allow(0), rl.allow(1), rl.allow(2), rl.allow(10)]
result = (out, rl.calls)

cases.name: denied_calls_never_count
cases.code:

cases.name: public_attributes_after_construction
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(3, 7)
result = (rl.max_calls, rl.window, rl.calls, type(rl.calls).__name__)

cases.name: calls_invariant_step_by_step
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(2, 5)
steps = []
for t in [0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 11]:
    ok = rl.allow(t)
    steps.append((t, ok, list(rl.calls), type(rl.calls).__name__))
result = steps

cases.name: instances_are_independent
cases.code:
a = sol.RateLimiter(1, 10)

out = [a.allow(0), b.allow(0), a.allow(1), b.allow(1)]

cases.name: higher_limit_sliding
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(3, 10)
out = []
for t in [0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 10, 12, 14, 20]:
    out.append((t, rl.allow(t), len(rl.calls)))
result = out
